$comment: The rule-pack format (FLR-T-6.3, rules/README.md): what one fixture of a rule expects, rules/<pack>/rules/<rule ID>/fixtures/<slug>/expect.json. The fixture's document is document.json beside it, or the pack's documents/<document>.json. tools/build-pack.ts evaluates every fixture with the oracle and compares.
title: Floorspec rule fixture
description: A Floorspec document and the outcome one rule is expected to have on it.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: pass: the rule is evaluated, has at least one subject (or exactly subjects) and no finding; fail: it is evaluated and its findings are on exactly the subjects listed; deferred: it uses a deferred measure and is not evaluated (FS-RULES-008).

findings.title: Subjects with findings
findings.description: For fail: the IDs of exactly the subjects that get a finding.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: The exact number of subjects, when the fixture means to pin it.

exempt.title: Exempt
exempt.description: The exact number of exempt subjects, when the fixture means to pin it.

document.title: Shared document
document.description: The name of a document in the pack's documents/ directory, instead of document.json beside this file.

extensions.title: Known extensions
extensions.description: The official extensions (registry/) the evaluator is configured with; default every one.
